mapper.select: SELECT mm.mail_idx, mm.issue_all_emp_flg, mrm.recipient_emp, mrm.recipient_type, em.emp_comp_mail, mcm.subject, mcm.content FROM mail_mgt AS mm INNER JOIN mail_issue_mgt AS mim ON mm.mail_idx = mim.mail_idx AND mim.issue_date::date = CURRENT_DATE AND mim.logical_del_flg = FALSE LEFT JOIN mail_recipient_mgt AS mrm ON mm.mail_idx = mrm.mail_idx AND mrm.logical_del_flg = FALSE LEFT JOIN emp_mgt AS em ON em.emp_id = mrm.recipient_emp AND em.logical_del_flg = FALSE INNER JOIN mail_contents_mgt AS mcm ON mm.mail_idx = mcm.mail_idx AND mcm.logical_del_flg = FALSE WHERE mm.issue_flg = TRUE AND mm.logical_del_flg = FALSE
SELECT emp_comp_mail FROM emp_mgt WHERE resign_flg = FALSE AND logical_del_flg = FALSE
